answer: Hollows are issued to an operator one at a time, and one hollow certifies only one identity. Certifying the kth hollow requires k prisms that certified no earlier hollow for that operator, each locking one zephyr into that hollow. Because one prism cannot lock a second zephyr into another of that operator's hollows, k clones burn 1+2+...+k zephyrs; the kth clone costs k fresh prisms and k zephyrs.
